{{Quote|Ransack the Republic's labs. Take their research, then destroy everything. We don't want them salvaging the project.|Agent [[Kayd]]|<ref name="TOR:BtC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Breaking the Cure|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The '''Republic Research Division''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] research facility located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The facility housed several laboratories operated by the Republic and by Republic-affiliated companies including [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], [[MediCure Pharmaceuticals]]<ref name="TOR:RRD" /> and [[ChemFlex]].<ref name="TOR:LA" />
